Show dorsal knuckles, back of hand and fingernail-side finger surfaces to camera. The left thumb must emerge on the inner/viewer-LEFT side of this raised hand, toward her torso; four fingers curl gently so their BACKS remain visible. No visible forward-facing palm silhouette. PALM AND FINGER PADS ARE OPEN/UNARMORED: no metal palm plate, no metal on gripping surfaces. They can remain mostly hidden facing away; any visible underside sliver shows natural skin. Armor covers dorsal surfaces only, not a sealed metal glove. Bare RIGHT fingertips still pluck the strings from above. Keep ONLY left arm armored, no bracer on right, no harp/lyre, no additional objects, no text or logos. One corrected portrait.
